leave_byte_identical: all seven original expected protocol tuples

public_input_api.SourceImage: pub struct SourceImage<'a> { pub width:u32, pub height:u32, pub rgba:&'a [u8] } (Copy/Clone/Debug)
public_input_api.Command: Add Image { rect: Rect, source: u32 } to existing Command. Existing rectangle/scope variants and Copy semantics remain.
public_input_api.ownership: Source and command slices are borrowed only during planning. Returned Plan owns all packed source, LUT and parameter bytes; no input lifetime or mutable reference is retained.

validated_output_api.Plan: All storage fields private; no public constructor or mutating accessors. Only the planner can produce a Plan.
validated_output_api.Draw: Private fields. DrawKind::{Rectangle,Image} is a Copy public discriminator returned by kind(); groups()->(u32,u32) remains public. bounds()->(u32,u32,u32,u32) may expose immutable integer bounds for diagnostics/tests. Image/source offsets remain planner-private and serialized in parameters.
validated_output_api.parameters_change: parameters() returns the immutable prebuilt byte slice instead of allocating a fresh Vec per call. Existing fixtures.rs only returns Plan and needs no edit; owned main/tests callers adapt.
validated_output_api.no_images: If no image dispatch survives coverage, input_bytes() is empty and has_images() is false. All supplied sources still undergo exact dimension/length/alpha/count/aggregate-byte validation, including unused and hidden sources. No input GPU buffer or dummy binding is created.

word_layout.byte_order: Every u32 explicitly little-endian; no unsafe cast or new dependency. Plan stores the single arena as Vec<u8> in word layout, avoiding a second u32-to-byte serialization buffer.

shared_first_32_bytes.name: packed rectangle color; zero for image

image_next_32_bytes.name: x LUT word count (= visible width)
y LUT word count (= visible height)

word_layout.padding: Rectangle bytes 32..256 remain zero exactly as before. Image bytes 64..256 are zero. Slots never change after planning.
word_layout.suggested_image_WGSL_struct: origin:vec2<u32>, extent:vec2<u32>, canvas:vec2<u32>, color:u32, reserved:u32, source:vec4<u32>, tables:vec4<u32>; offsets 0,8,16,24,28,32,48; size/alignment 64/16.
word_layout.input_arena_order: If any image draw exists: concatenate packed source pixels for EVERY supplied source in source-table order, row-major within each image, then append each visible image draw x table followed by its y table in display-list order. All offsets/counts are words. Rectangle draws append no input words. Duplicate source IDs reuse the original packed region; identical separate source entries are not content-deduplicated.

planning_phases: Validate frame, source count <=256, nonzero source dimensions, checked exact RGBA lengths and total declared source bytes <=1048576 before source scans or source-size allocations. Validate all alpha bytes once per supplied source. No source-area scan per command.

Walk <=256 typed commands with <=32 combined scopes. Validate all image source references and unsupported content before skipping empty/clipped geometry. Retain existing rectangle coverage unchanged; image coverage applies both integer-origin clip edges. Build at most257 bounded draw drafts including clear; image draft temporarily retains original translated rect/source ID and integer output bounds.

Accumulate rounded8x8 invocation count <=4000000 and total LUT entries <=143360 with checked arithmetic. Determine whether any image dispatch exists. Compute exact GPU byte sum:8*W*H+256*draws+(has_images?4*(all_source_pixels+all_lut_entries):0), require <=1048576 before arena/parameter allocation.

Reserve exact bounded byte capacities with fallible allocation. If images exist, pack each already validated source once in source order; append x/y tables in draw order using the exact original translated-rect f32 expression and final index bounds. This performs one alpha-validation pass and one packing pass, both bounded by source bytes; table work is bounded by visible width+height.

Serialize immutable per-draw parameter slots; finalize private Draw/Plan storage. Neither Plan nor source-byte accessors allow mutation. Caller changes to original RGBA after return cannot alter plan bytes.

GPU_integration.old_rectangle_path: Original rect.wgsl and its two-binding pipeline/layout remain unchanged. No additional buffer is allocated for any of the seven old rectangle-only fixtures.
GPU_integration.dispatch: One ordered compute pass per Draw, select rectangle or image pipeline and corresponding bind group. Use slot_index*256 dynamic offset. Image shader reads two LUT indices and one packed source word and writes one output word after explicit guards. Clear remains first rectangle dispatch.
GPU_integration.guards: Validate tail lanes, canvas/output range, LUT base/count ranges before loads, source base/count range before loads, sx/sy/source dimensions and safe row product. Use subtraction-based range guards where needed to avoid unchecked offset wrap. No error/sentinel/counter GPU buffer is added.
GPU_integration.lifetime: Upload immutable metadata and conditional input arena once per fixture, submit ordered passes and output-to-readback copy together, wait/map/compare/unmap, then release before next fixture. Existing timeouts/error scopes/supervisor caveats remain.
GPU_integration.memory: Exactly output+readback+parameters+[optional one input arena] explicit buffers. Native upload staging remains excluded from1MiB allocation accounting and documented; no target-pixel upload or additional direct dependency.
